author: mvafin
title: Conformance (OP) Pack Artifacts fails - tar file changed as we read it
signature: tar file changed as we read it|Configuration
key_errors: tar: conformance_artifacts.tar.gz: file changed as we read it
root_cause: The Pack Conformance Artifacts step runs 'tar -cvf - * | pigz > ${CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/conformance_artifacts.tar.gz' from within CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR itself. This means tar tries to archive conformance_artifacts.tar.gz (the output file) as part of the glob '*', causing tar to detect it changed while being read/written. This is a pre-existing workflow configuration bug unrelated to the PR changes (ONNX FE external data offset fix).
reproduction_steps: N/A - occurs only in CI due to configuration issue in Pack Conformance Artifacts step
recommended_actions: Fix the Pack Conformance Artifacts step to write output to a path outside CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR, or exclude the output file from tar's glob (e.g., use --exclude='conformance_artifacts.tar.gz').
prevention_strategies: Write tar output to a parent/sibling directory, or use tar --exclude to exclude the output file.
historical_context: This same failure was seen twice before (2026-07-28 and 2026-08-11) in the Conformance (API) job with the same root cause.
